title: SkillDefinition
description: One standard Agent Skill as the Worker Functionality coordinator persists it: the skill's standard name, the universal root that holds (or will hold) its directory, and — for a Worker-installed skill — the standard installer package reference it came from.

name.description: The standard Agent Skills name: lowercase words joined by single hyphens, equal to the skill's directory name.

scope.description: The universal Agent Skills root: the project's `.agents/skills` or the user's `~/.agents/skills`.

source.description: The standard installer package reference (`owner/repo`, a git URL, or a local path) that provides the skill; required to add a skill that is not yet installed.
